xp.shareHint: Post about fly.ai from your linked X account, then paste the link: +20 XP, once a day.
xp.shareDone: Today's post is in. Come back tomorrow.
xp.connectX: Connect your X account in the account menu to share for XP.
xp.seasonOver: Season 1 is over. XP counted toward the airdrop.
xp.h_intro: XP adds up through Season 1 and counts toward the airdrop. It updates about every 10 minutes.
xp.h_hold: Hold $FLYAI: 10 XP a day per 200k. Staked or locked: 12.5.
xp.h_flies: Active Trader Flies: 10 XP a day each, while your wallet holds 200k $FLYAI.
xp.h_streak: Streak: +10% on holding and fly XP for every week you don't sell, up to 2x. A sell starts it again.
xp.h_deposits: Fly wallet deposits of $10 or more: 10 XP per $1. Taking your deposit back out takes its XP; profit doesn't.
xp.h_feed: Feed the Fly Desk: 10 XP per $1 your fly leaves in.
xp.h_market: Marketplace: 1 XP per 10k $FLYAI traded, buyer and seller.
xp.h_buy: Buy $FLYAI in our swap box (/start): 1 XP per 10k bought.
xp.h_claimstake: Claim and stake a Fly Desk payout within the hour: 50 XP.
xp.h_badges: Badges you claim: common 25, uncommon 100, rare 250, legendary 500.
xp.h_referrals: Referrals: +10% of the XP of everyone you bring who becomes a real referral.
xp.h_x: X: 50 XP for connecting your account, 20 XP a day for a post about fly.ai.
xp.h_flybook: Flybook: 5 XP a day you like, comment, poke or caption (for holders and fly owners).
xp.h_foot: Team wallets and fly wallets aren't ranked. Levels: level 1 at 50 XP, 2 at 200, 3 at 450, 10 at 5,000.
xp.h_telegram: Telegram: 50 XP while your connected account is in the fly.ai group (checked daily).
